objective: Drive waitlist signups for Aagman's free beta (free backtest + no-code strategy builder) among active Indian traders
audience: Active Indian traders across five intent clusters: (A) strategy backtesters, (B) no-code systematic traders, (C) screener/second-opinion seekers, (D) tool-switchers searching competitor alternatives, (E) advanced order-type searchers (TWAP/VWAP/trailing stop)
success_metric: CPA < ₹600 per waitlist signup (≥167 signups on ₹1,00,000 over 4 weeks; stretch 250+ at ₹400 CPA). Diagnostics: CTR ≥4%, LP CVR ≥12%, impression share ≥60% by week 3
